title: Rooms & Accommodations | Bali Lush
meta_description: Our eco retreat in Bali offers three gorgeous free-standing bungalows that include a perfect fusion of Indonesian architecture and modern western comforts. Explore our rooms and book your stay. Each space can accommodate anywhere from small parties of 2 to larger parties of 5.  Select a room to see additional details.
